posts.meta_description:
46K likes, 366 comments - bruisedpassports on December 2, 2022: "2022 in 10 photos 🌍🐧December is here - that time of the year where all of us look back, express gratitude, and SET INTENTIONS for the coming year 😊🗓 

Here are some memorable highlights of 2022 for us ⬆️ 

•We explored 9 new countries & revisited several old favourites ✈️ 
•Published a book & it became a best-seller within days, thanks to all of you 📕 
• Continued our dream of spreading education by building a computer lab for kids who did not have access to digital education 💻 
•Vid continued to spoil every single selfie we took but nothing new there 🤣
•Shot a global campaign for Ted Baker’s website & stores worldwide 📺 
•Launched Thailand tourisms’ new chapter as a Responsible destination 🇹🇭 
•Received lots of accolades for our work from being featured in Forbes list of 100 Digital Stars to Cosmo Travel Blogger of the year 🏆 
•Met so many of you at book signings, airports, and meet-ups in far-away lands from Kenya to Chile - always so special. I might be biased but Bruisedpassports fam is the BEST 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
•And perhaps most importantly, in a world full of crumbling half-baked relationships, I’m MOST GRATEFUL to be surrounded by an incredible partner and amazing friends and family💗

Ok now you go - What is the one thing you are PROUDEST of this year? Tell us so we can congratulate you too 🤗💜
✨
✨
#bruisedpassports #travel #love #life #2022 #newyear".

posts.meta_description:
bruisedpassports on October 7, 2026: "This isn’t about influence anymore.It’s about impact 😇✨

Spoke at Entrepreneur Summit 2026 this week about the importance of reinventing constantly alongside some of the most brilliant founders in the country, and left the room feeling genuinely excited about what lies ahead.

We spoke about what happens when years of lived experience, understanding people and spotting travel trends translate into ideas that can actually move the needle-for brands, platforms and travellers alike 🌍😇

As we continue building the Bruised Passports App, moments like these feel particularly full circle. From engineer → to creator → to Key Opinion Leader → to building a technology product of our own ⭕️ 

The medium is pivoting. The ambition has grown. But the curiosity that started it all remains exactly the same. Same curiosity. Sharper lens. Bigger vision. 
So excited for what lies ahead 🤞🌍

#bruisedpassports #entrepreneurship #startup".

posts.meta_description:
bruisedpassports on October 6, 2026: "Overthinker meet problem solver 😇📝

After years of travelling together, you’d think we’d have packing down to a science 😅 But somehow, our essential gear bag decided to disappear right before a flight 🫣

Luckily, a little Amazon Great Indian Festival browsing turned our packing panic into a much-needed upgrade. From headphones to travel gear, there are some pretty WOW deals to look forward to.

The Amazon Great Indian Festival starts 8th October with min. 70% off on electronics 💫

#amazonindia #amazongreatindianfestival #bruisedpassports #travel".

posts.meta_description:
bruisedpassports on October 4, 2026: "As a girl growing up in India, I often heard women have to sacrifice their dreams or that the Indian passport makes it impossible to travel! What can I say? My parents brought me up to never say no to a challenge! 😇🌍

There are many more dreams yet to work on but beginning October feeling strangely content - a kind of content I’ve actually never felt before 😌🌍

Putting this here because if you too have been quietly dreaming of something, this is your sign to make it happen!✨ No dream is ever too big or too far-fetched. You don’t even have to know how to get there-you just need to be brave enough to reach for it & have the persistence to show up daily! 💌🤍 Happy October everyone ✨

#bruisedpassports #travel #dreams".

posts.meta_description:
bruisedpassports on September 27, 2026: "Expedition 🤝 Indulgence 🍽️

Ever since we started Bruised Passports, there’s been one thing we’ve always recommended: when travelling to remote places with harsh weather, make sure you have plenty of creature comforts if you want the holiday to be truly memorable 🌍😇

After days spent adventuring in the cold, there’s something especially lovely about settling in for an unhurried dinner aboard @ponant , with Arctic landscapes stretching out beyond the windows, caviar, desserts, and endless conversations. It’s these little moments of comfort, together, that make the wildest journeys feel even more special 🌍❄️❄️

A rather lovely way to wind down an extraordinary journey. Bye Norway - it was truly a September to remember 🥹❄️🌍

#bruisedpassports #travel #norway".
